help: Rerolls the current NPC's unaccepted custom bounties. Optional type (for example derelict) forces native military/underworld offers to that registered type; optional difficulty must fit that type. Default level is at least 5. Use status alone in a loaded campaign to inspect the Derelict generator and Orion THEME_HIDDEN coverage without opening a contact. Accepted missions and other jobs are preserved.

Adds 1-10 native bounty difficulty levels (default 5) to each unaccepted bounty family offered by the current NPC. Progress is shared across contacts using that family. Run RefreshContactBounties afterward.
Installs the expedition only when every expedition world is absent and no departure progress exists. One attempt per campaign; never rebuilds surviving content.
Adds Hyperspace Topography event progress for testing. Progress is capped at the currently installed event's maximum.
Spawns a Starving Threat First or Second Strike near the player in Ashen Verge and immediately attacks the nearest surviving FOB Ithaca bastion.
Spawns three full Starving Threat Third Strike invasion fleets in Ashen Verge; during Labor V this resets their 60-day bastion sieges.
Skips the prerequisite Labors and immediately activates a fresh Labor V defense of FOB Ithaca.
Immediately removes only the idle owned Breach Defense Station. Ordinary pre-assault maintenance may rebuild it; Labor flags and other fleets are unchanged.
Enables all six Ithaca defense components without changing Labor or research-station progress.
